# Bito AI

> > Bito provides deep codebase context and intelligence for AI coding agents like Cursor and Claude, plus automated code review agents for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.

Bito's flagship products include AI Architect (a knowledge graph system providing system-level codebase context via MCP integration) and AI Code Review Agent (automated, codebase-aware PR reviews). The platform integrates with popular IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains) and Git platforms, emphasizing enterprise security with SOC 2 Type II compliance.

## Key Topics

- AI Architect
- Codebase Context
- Knowledge Graph
- AI Coding Agents
- Code Review Automation
- Cursor Integration
- Claude Integration
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket
- Developer Productivity
- System-Level Analysis
- Pull Request Automation
- SWE-Bench Pro
- Enterprise Security (SOC 2)
- VS Code & JetBrains Extensions

## Core Products

- [Bito Homepage](https://bito.ai): Main landing page: AI Architect provides system-level codebase context for agents
- [AI Architect](https://bito.ai/product/ai-architect): Knowledge graph system for Cursor and Claude via MCP integration
- [AI Code Review Agent](https://bito.ai/product/ai-code-review-agent): Automated codebase-aware reviews for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket
- [Pricing](https://bito.ai/pricing): Team ($15), Professional ($25), and Enterprise plans with Git/IDE support

## Enterprise & Security

- [Enterprise Solutions](https://bito.ai/enterprise): Enterprise landing page for AI Architect and codebase intelligence
- [Enterprise Security](https://bito.ai/enterprise/security): SOC 2 Type II compliance, no code storage, AWS Bedrock/Azure AI integration
- [Case Studies](https://bito.ai/case-studies): Customer success stories from Privado, Apica, and Gainsight
